title: Iron Jetpacks Refabricated
description: The unofficial Fabric port of Iron Jetpacks, a Forge and Neoforge mod adding tiered jetpacks, by BlakeBr0.
body:
Iron Jetpacks Refabricated is the unofficial Fabric port of BlakeBr0's Iron Jetpacks, a jetpack mod with semi-modern elements that provides a lot of features but remains simple to use.

Compatibility
- Trinkets
- Trinkets Updated
- Solar Flux Reborn (Fabric coming soon)
- Chargers ReFabricated (Coming soon)

Features

- Tiered jetpacks built with vanilla and modded resources.
- Operates through Fabric's Energy API, providing compatibility across most Fabric tech mods.
- Allows control of flight speed through the use of throttle functionality.
- An expansive config enabling you to surpass normal jetpack flight speeds.
- Features an integrated HUD that displays energy levels, engine state, hovering state, and throttle level.
- The position, particles, sound effects, tool tips, and back tank rendering can all be configured via the config.
- Trinkets is now supported, allowing for jetpacks to be used in a trinket slot, and chestplate slot separately.

Other Minecraft versions may be considered if there is enough interest. Please open a GitHub issue with the version you want (only if the version is not already open!).
